notes: Fixes Export CAN app, which in v0.18.0 showed the explanation and then nothing to pick. A framework AlertDialog shows either a message or a list, never both - it only attaches the list when there is no message - so the picker was silently dropped. The explanation now ends in a Choose app button that opens the list. Read serial port had exactly the same bug and is fixed the same way: the warning now ends in Pick a port. Nothing else changed - the AIDL probe and the APK export itself were fine, they were just unreachable.
